applicability.reason: RedactGuard has critical Android document-protection journeys and a cross-process Local AI boundary whose complete outcomes require E2E evidence, while emulator and physical-device evidence support materially different claims.

target_environments.description: A built RedactGuard APK installed on a supported Android device and exercised through production app surfaces, Android document APIs and process-local privacy behavior.
material_dimensions: built APK install and Android process lifecycle
production Compose UI and Android framework behavior
text/PDF ingestion review redaction export and reopen behavior

target_environments.description: RedactGuard and Harnex installed as independently signed applications on a physical Android target, using the Consumer SDK/Binder boundary, exact Harnex Control Plane authorization and the real Harnex-owned runtime/model path.
material_dimensions: exact RedactGuard APK source revision package signer and Consumer SDK version
exact Harnex APK source revision package signer preset and capability identity
distinct real distribution signing identities and explicit Harnex authorization state
install-order independence without requiring RedactGuard reinstall
real Consumer SDK Binder and cross-process lifecycle
real model runtime device ABI and Android process behavior

execution_environments.artifact_surface: built RedactGuard debug APK plus AndroidTest APK using production Compose/document/redaction/export code and a deterministic AnalysisRuntimePort response
known_gaps: Local AI Harnex APK Consumer SDK Binder native runtime and GGUF/model execution are not present
emulator hardware and framework implementation do not establish physical OEM/device behavior
physical-device accessibility performance thermal and resource behavior are not established

execution_environments.platform: GitHub-hosted Linux + Android API 35 Google APIs x86_64 emulator
execution_environments.artifact_surface: separately built and installed Harnex and RedactGuard APKs signed with distinct ephemeral identities, with RedactGuard installed before Harnex in the install-order proof, using the exact Consumer SDK candidate, real Android Binder Service, source-observed Harnex Control Plane authorization, activation/residency and RuntimeOrchestrator; native GGUF execution remains outside this environment
known_gaps: ephemeral CI signing identities prove independent-signer authorization semantics but are not the actual Google Play App Signing identities
x86_64 emulator does not execute the production arm64-v8a llama.cpp/JNI backend
real GGUF bytes, model-load cost, physical memory, thermal and OEM behavior remain physical-device evidence
the Harnex emulator ModelStore mirrors production inventory semantics but does not establish physical model/runtime behavior

execution_environments.platform: GitHub-hosted Linux + Android API 35 Google APIs x86_64 emulator
execution_environments.artifact_surface: debug-testable Harnex and RedactGuard artifacts configured with the production application IDs io.github.daniele21.localllm.phonetest and io.github.daniele21.redactguard, separately signed with distinct ephemeral CI identities, using the exact Harnex Consumer SDK candidate and real Binder/Control Plane authorization for pending, authorize, disable, reauthorize, Host restart and replacement-signer transitions
known_gaps: ephemeral CI signing identities are not the actual Google Play App Signing identities
debug-testable release-package topology does not establish release/R8 packaging behavior
x86_64 emulator does not execute the production arm64-v8a llama.cpp/JNI backend or real GGUF bytes
physical memory, thermal, OEM lifecycle and distribution-channel behavior remain physical-device evidence

execution_environments.artifact_surface: exact RedactGuard and Harnex APKs installed from the intended distribution channel with independent signer/source/preset identity, real Consumer SDK/Binder/runtime path, synthetic fixtures and bounded operator-attested product checkpoints
known_gaps: one representative physical device does not establish every supported OEM/API/device combination
operator attestations are required for SAF review recovery export and persistence checkpoints
performance thermal accessibility and protected-release claims require their own explicit protocols when asserted

critical_journeys.claim: User can paste text, choose protection, run local analysis, review each finding, redact or ignore it, and reach a valid export outcome without exposing sensitive values by default.
residual_gaps: the two-APK emulator proves the real cross-process Consumer path but not production ARM64 JNI/GGUF execution
physical Android OEM/accessibility behavior is not established by the emulator

critical_journeys.claim: User can import a text PDF, choose protection, analyze locally, review findings, export the redacted PDF and reopen the output with the expected redactions.
residual_gaps: the PDF journey still uses deterministic AnalysisRuntimePort behavior rather than the two-APK Harnex path
physical document-provider/OEM behavior outside the emulator remains representative-device evidence

critical_journeys.claim: In Settings the user can understand RedactGuard-to-Harnex connectivity, explicitly disconnect without lifecycle auto-reconnect defeating that preference, reconnect on demand, recover from pending authorization by opening Harnex, observe Harnex-side disable as fail-closed on a fresh connection, recover after explicit reauthorization, and see signer replacement fail closed until reauthorized.
residual_gaps: the emulators use ephemeral distinct signers rather than the actual Play App Signing identities
the release-identity emulator uses debug-testable artifacts and does not establish release/R8 packaging
physical accessibility and OEM lifecycle behavior remain representative-device evidence

critical_journeys.claim: In Settings the user can inspect the robust default analysis prompt, edit a draft with inline validation, save a custom prompt, see the Custom state, reopen the editor, reset the draft and explicitly save back to Default while protected integrity rules remain non-editable.
residual_gaps: emulator media does not establish physical-device accessibility, keyboard/OEM behavior or human usability
real ARM64/GGUF response quality to the resulting prompt remains separate runtime evidence

critical_journeys.claim: When local AI is unavailable or RedactGuard is not yet authorized, the user sees an actionable state, and after Harnex becomes available or authorization is granted the real Consumer/Binder path reconnects and analysis reaches a valid review state without reinstalling RedactGuard or exposing partial findings.
residual_gaps: production Play signing identity and ARM64 native/model/resource recovery remain physical-device evidence

critical_journeys.claim: After RedactGuard starts a Harnex-backed analysis, sending the app to Android Home and returning does not implicitly cancel or duplicate the accepted work: the same process-local AnalysisJobId remains authoritative and the user returns to the active or completed analysis state.
residual_gaps: x86_64 emulator evidence does not establish ARM64 JNI/GGUF model residency or decode continuity
Samsung and other OEM background scheduling, memory pressure, thermal behavior and process reclamation require representative physical evidence
true Harnex process death remains a truthful interruption and is not claimed as transparent native continuation

critical_journeys.claim: RedactGuard can be installed before a separately installed independently signed Harnex, reach the explicit Binder service without a custom bind permission or reinstall, be denied while its exact observed identity is pending, succeed only after explicit Harnex authorization, remain denied after Harnex disables that identity until explicit reauthorization, connect/disconnect/reconnect, and remain fail-closed across signer replacement while recovering cleanly across Host restart.
residual_gaps: production Play App Signing identities remain the physical distribution confirmation
the release-identity emulator does not establish release/R8 packaging
production ARM64 JNI/llama.cpp and real GGUF byte execution remain physical two-APK confirmation
physical memory thermal and OEM lifecycle behavior remain REAL_ENVIRONMENT
